def: An open framework and hub from Meta's PyTorch team and Hugging Face that packages agentic RL environments as Docker images exposing Gymnasium-style reset(), step() and state() calls.
practice: Launched on 23 October 2025 with a 0.1 spec RFC; TRL, SkyRL, Unsloth, ART and torchforge integrate with it, and it describes itself as in early development (as of November 2026).
